feature.level_2: Evaluator, Reward, Contract, and Governance (Judge Calibration / Reward Modeling / CEGIS)
feature.description: Improves acceptance rules, rewards, gates, and policies. Validate with golden sets, agreement rates, and violation tests.

contract.purpose_user_function: Calibrate evaluator contracts, thresholds, rewards, and governance policies using labeled/golden cases and violation evidence.
contract.valid_inputs: Evaluator/rule version, golden cases, reviewer/verdict history, thresholds/rewards, policy constraints, agreement/error metrics, and candidate change.
contract.expected_outputs: Calibration metrics, candidate contract/policy, agreement/violation comparison, and approval-gated adoption decision.
contract.state_side_effects: Writes evaluation/evolution artifacts and may promote approved policy/config versions.
contract.failure_rejection_behavior: Agreement degradation, golden-case error, violation, reward hacking signal, missing independence, or approval denial rejects candidate.
contract.supported_boundaries_exclusions: Eval packs, verification gates, and generic evolution exist; dedicated judge-calibration/reward-model training and CEGIS policy synthesis are not unified.
contract.success_evidence: Candidate beats predefined golden/agreement metrics and passes violation tests while preserving independent evaluation.
contract.granularity_atomic_contracts: golden pass/fail; inter-review agreement; threshold boundary; violation suite; reward-hacking negative; promote/rollback.
